user.title: My Verisure Authentication
user.description: Enter your My Verisure account credentials to connect to your security system.

phone_selection.title: Select Phone Number
phone_selection.description: Select which phone number should receive the OTP code for two-factor authentication.

otp_verification.title: Enter OTP Code
otp_verification.description: Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to your selected phone number.

installation.title: Select Installation
installation.description: Select which My Verisure installation you want to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your My Verisure credentials have expired. Please re-enter them.

error.cannot_persist: Could not persist the authenticated session
error.cannot_get_installations: Could not get installations from My Verisure
error.installation_not_found: The selected installation is no longer available
error.otp_invalid_phone: The selected phone number is not available for this OTP challenge
error.otp_no_phone_destinations: My Verisure requires OTP verification, but no phone destination is available
error.otp_data_missing: The OTP challenge data is incomplete. Please restart authentication
error.authentication_required: Authentication must be completed before selecting an installation
error.otp_reauth_required: Two-factor authentication required again. Please reconfigure the integration to provide a new OTP code.
error.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please reconfigure the integration to authenticate again.
